listing.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98] Kon's Multi-Pack v.6.0.6 - 13th Battlegroup Player Faction

description:
Expands player faction and flavor for the faction with custom descriptions,

fleet names, fleet dialogue, etc. As a template, it is heavily commented out

for anyone who wants to make their own changes to their file to really bring

out the faction that they want and have the description reflect it. It should

now be more accessible than ever before.
descriptionHtml:
Expands player faction and flavor for the faction with custom descriptions,
fleet names, fleet dialogue, etc. As a template, it is heavily commented out
for anyone who wants to make their own changes to their file to really bring
out the faction that they want and have the description reflect it. It should
now be more accessible than ever before.
aiDescription: Expands the player faction with custom descriptions, fleet names, and dialogue. Includes a heavily commented template for easy customization and a default preset for the Lost Battalion. Makes the faction feel more integrated into the game world.
saveCompatibilityText: safe to add, remove, all saves
